1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves the incorrect syntax highlighting of Python identifiers in highlight.js. This breaks proper syntax coloring and can cause confusion, especially for Python code where such names are legal and common. The issue appears to originate in changes made around version 11.0.0, affecting how the language definition for Python (and potentially the keyword-matching logic itself) processes tokens.
